core_principle: sample transition-discriminating phylogenetic neighbourhoods and populations, not a fixed number of species

candidate_universe.record_count_interpretation: authority records, not 161 guaranteed independent species; retain varieties/synonyms/infraspecific concepts until reconciliation
candidate_universe.literature_context: Moreyra et al. 2025 states that Japan harbours more than 100 Cirsium species and sampled 38 Japanese species

outputs: authority taxon concept and Japanese name
A0_authority_screen.authority_trait_state_ceiling: screening prior only; not an individual measurement or ancestral state

A1_fixed_focal_population_layer.m01_nested_rna: six floral collections/population, five primary RNA-seq libraries plus one reserve

A1_rad_assay_pilot.polyploid_rule: if A2/A3 introduces high-ploidy or polyploid concepts, require a second stratum-specific assay check before their production RAD

A2_backbone_augmentation.primary_assay: Comp1061-compatible target capture or separately justified compatible nuclear placement assay
nomination_requirements: explicit authority trait state relevant to a core module or direct polymorphism evidence
nonredundant state contrast or missing phylogenetic bracket
no close-relative claim based on geography alone
A2_backbone_augmentation.ambiguous_placement_rule: retain network/hybrid/polyploid uncertainty; do not force a sister pair

A3_transition_neighbourhoods.P01: JPN36 is fixed; add comparator taxa only when nuclear placement distinguishes terminal versus internal/alternative-edge histories
A3_transition_neighbourhoods.P02: JPN06-JPN15 is fixed; add species only for a specified topology/network ambiguity

P03.selection_basis: discrete history discrimination across the admitted topology/minimum-history ensemble, not posterior probability mass
requirements: distinct candidate transition edge/neighbourhood from other slots
placed comparator lineage(s) sufficient to distinguish terminal versus deeper placement
two populations of one species do not count as two evolutionary-transition slots
JPN36 can count at most once

A3_transition_neighbourhoods.P04: reuse A1/A3 same individuals; no separate quota unless reconstruction-aware null identifies a coverage gap
A3_transition_neighbourhoods.P05: measurement-first on A1/A3 plants; no RAD expansion solely for continuous-trait sample size

added_neighbourhood_population_default.narrow_endemic_exception: one verified population allowed with explicit limitation
added_neighbourhood_population_default.within_species_polymorphism_rule: prefer >=3 populations and >=10 primary individuals per observed state across >=2 populations where feasible so morph is not identical to locality

open_only_after: ancestral-state/pigment history distinguishes H1/H2 from H3 at the stated ceiling
corolla-expression association replicates across both discovery populations within each lineage
added_populations: one intermediate Amami-group C. brevicaule population
one southern Amami-group C. brevicaule population
m01_expansion.selection_boundary: RAD supplies background population structure; candidate-region evidence requires independent non-RAD confirmation

method_roles.rad: population ancestry, admixture, reticulation and morph/population history inside qualified neighbourhoods
